issues: A thin line circle on flat light grey turns into an empty outline; the shot has almost no light, material or depth
The subject took only ~27% of frame width (a 520×300 card), so it barely registered at 1080p
Card content was 13–26px task-card text (or grey skeleton bars) that was unreadable when scaled down
The breath was weak and both axes interpolated together, so the morph read as uniform scaling rather than growth
changes: Switched to the graphite dark look: the primitive is now a glowing 'listening' orb (warm white-to-champagne radial light, bright rim, seven bouncing waveform bars), and the stage light and floor bounce follow its brightness
The breath is a slow inhale to 1.14, a crisp 7f exhale down to 0.94 as an anticipation crouch, then back to 1 during the morph
The isomorphic path times x and y separately: width grows first and height follows 3f later, each with ~2% overshoot, so the growth has weight

The light uses a fixed-center userSpace radial gradient, so it stays round and blooms outward while dimming and the dark card face grows from its edge; 54–70f solidifies it (rim to hairline, outer glow to two soft shadows) with a single sheen clipped to the corners

The target card is 1120×640 (58% of width) and is now an AI meeting recap: an 80px title rising word by word, three 36px decisions landing with champagne checks drawing in, and a waveform growing from the left and slowly playing; the orb shrinks into the card's top-left icon
Duration 140→150f, with a slow 2.5% push-in keeping the hold alive
